atomicSteps: 1. Verify clean git status and valid new bundle/images/ directory
2. Perform atomic pre-upgrade PostgreSQL database snapshot to /opt/tenants/<id>/snapshots/<timestamp>/
3. Snapshot OpenBao secrets and encryption keys
4. Push updated OCI container images into local in-cluster Zot registry
5. Apply updated Flux GitOps tenant manifests via flux reconcile
6. Execute health check probes against API, dashboard, and agent endpoints
7. If health checks fail, automatically rollback database snapshot and GitOps revision
